summary: Make the inactive jobs receipt-level idempotency contention fixture deterministic.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay hooks or triggers.

rules.detail: Thread A reserves under BEGIN IMMEDIATE and holds its write lock until thread B's SQLite busy handler has fired. B retries contention with an explicit 30-second deadline, then must receive ExistingJob carrying A's ID.

compatibility.detail: The test explicitly identifies persistent receipts as the idempotency mechanism and still requires exactly one persisted receipt and one distinct job ID. No production behavior changes.

manual.detail: No operator action. Rust verification is not run in this assignment.
